title: Split of a padded string
statement: Let $y,w$ be bit strings with $|w|=|y|+1$. The odd split of their concatenation $yw$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding $\langle y,w\rangle$.
replaced: For bit strings $y$ and $w$ with $|w| = |y| + 1$, the odd split of $yw$, namely the self-delimiting pair encoding of its first $i$ bits and its remaining bits where $|yw| = 2i + 1$, equals $\langle y, w\rangle$.
